title: The understanding students with 600 more people, and a student that reads the person's words
request: The owner: 'the student model must have more ability' (plan 2026-10-25 Part B2).
spec: State students per workflow point and a text student for problem.family, trained on the new homework and the older journeys, measured on dev beside the rule, judged once on 150 sealed people written apart, under a gate fixed before it.
plan: Collect: play the new people once, merge the older rows, one split per person (the store's).
Train state students and the text student; report dev beside the rule and the rule on the new people.
Write the gate's dev figures, commit, then read the sealed people once.

decisions.decision: A person's split is the store's (datasets.split_of of dataset:journey:<set>:<id>), its sealed share dev.
decisions.why: The kept plays carry the same key: a person trained on here is train in the store too; store-sealed people are never trained on.

decisions.decision: A text student reads the written person's words and answers.
decisions.why: The 26.3 gate's note: a state student cannot read the family (0.526 against the rules' 0.895); the words are invented, so they may be read.

decisions.decision: The gate refuses to run until its dev figures are written into it and committed.
decisions.why: A gate fixed after its sealed set is read is not a gate.

decisions.decision: The sealed people's plays are never kept.
decisions.why: A kept play is shaped by the store: a sealed person would enter training.

change: dclab_rnd/understand_students.py (new: collect, train, gate), dclab_rnd/live_people.py (new, B3), dclab_rnd/lake/answers.py (the sealed guard, the homework split), tests/test_understand_students.py and tests/test_live_people.py (new).
outcome: Built; the collection, the dev figures and the one sealed read follow.
risks: The state students may still not beat the rule: their state holds no words.
